data.one_liner: Composable infinite pan/zoom canvas widget for Flutter with camera control.
data.what_it_does: Provides a zoomable and pannable 2D coordinate space for Flutter. It supports draggable world items, fixed viewport overlays, boundary constraints, and programmatic camera navigation.
use_when: Building node editors, flowcharts, or mind maps
Developing design tools, whiteboards, or visual planning apps
Displaying large data visualizations or network diagrams
avoid_when: Creating simple scrolling lists or grids
Working with fixed-size content where regular layouts are simpler
Building text-heavy interfaces where zooming can hurt readability
strengths: Drop-in solution working with any Flutter widgets
Handles complex gesture conflicts between panning, zooming, and item dragging
Supports world and viewport mixing for fixed UI elements
weaknesses: Early version with an evolving public API that may include breaking changes
Most testing has been done on desktop and web, requiring validation on mobile
